who i am

I'm a Computer Science student at Al-Ahliyya Amman University with a growing interest in creative technology, AI, and UI/UX design. Somewhere between writing code and choosing a typeface, I found the work I actually want to do.

Outside of coursework, that curiosity became Ramanova — a small creative practice where I design invitations, build AI-assisted visuals, and explore motion graphics for people celebrating something worth remembering.

AI & creative concepts
personal concept

NovaCafé — designing an app around a mascot, not a menu

A self-directed concept exploring what a cafe ordering app could feel like with a friendly character at its center — from onboarding to browsing hot drinks, cold drinks, and sweets.

It's part of how I practice UI thinking outside of coursework — playing with layout, color, and character-led branding using AI-assisted tools.
